offset by extracting matchAdvertisedModelValue into cursorAdvertisedModels.ts. +7 (PR #483 polish) for the extension emitChunk session guard that drops a create_plan/update_todos chunk naming a superseded session so it can't misroute into the next turn's queue. +36 (PR #483 P2 fix) for racing host.approval against the per-turn cancel signal in handlePermissionRequest (raceApprovalAgainstCancel + APPROVAL_CANCELLED sentinel) so a pending session/request_permission RPC resolves cancelled on cancel()/transport-close instead of hanging until the 5s escalation. +9 (PR #483 P2 fix) for session-guarding patchTurnMetadata (mirrors the emitChunk guard) so a stale/cancelled create_plan resolving against a superseded turn can't set planCompleted and open an empty approval card on a later turn. +12 (PR #483 P2 fix) for decoupling the cancel escalation's liveness check from this.activeTurn (a consumer bailing out of query() on cancel nulls activeTurn and would silently disarm escalation): a per-turn promptSettled flag set by the prompt RPC's settle chain now drives armCancelEscalation, so a wedged agent still gets terminated and the process recycled at the 5s mark. +7 (PR #483 P2 fix) for arming currentTurnIsPlan only after applyMode leaves the tracked mode at 'plan' (a rejected set_mode now runs the turn non-plan instead of letting ordinary assistant text open the post-plan approval card). +11 (PR #483 P1/P2 fix) for blocking cursor/create_plan on the user's plan decision in-turn via host.exitPlanMode (mapping approve/feedback/dismissal/cancel onto the documented accepted/rejected/cancelled outcome union) plus the markPlanDecidedInline seam that suppresses the post-turn planCompleted card, and a startup-cancel gate in query() that bails before session/prompt when Stop is pressed during setup; offset by dropping the emitChunk plan-content special-case and the patchTurnMetadata seam. +4 (approve-new-session fix) for the requestTurnCancel extension hook wired to cancel(): approve-new-session now rejects the plan AND fires session/cancel so the agent stops implementing in the abandoned session (cancelRequested alone only unwinds the consumer loop).
